title: Nutty Aromatic Northern Thai Chicken Curry
description: A buttery and molten Northern Thai chicken curry featuring bay leaf, perfect for a lazy Sunday, made with ingredients that follow Ayurvedic rajasic principles for a balancing meal.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the chicken to the pan and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the curry paste to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the bay leaf, fish sauce, brown sugar, and salt to the pan and stir to combine.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the curry simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the chopped peanuts and continue to simmer for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the bay leaf from the pan and serve the curry hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
